name: Flippy
source:
The mayor of Toontown. Flippy strives to be a supportive individual and a strong leader capable of guiding his fellow toons. However, Flippy struggles with low self-esteem and is constantly doubting his abilities as a leader.

[spoiler]According to [url=/c143314]Giggles,[/url] Flippy misused his power as mayor started an illegal draft in Toontown. He has no memories of this due to his amnesia.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]After accidentally injuring [url=/c143286]Clara[/url] and failing to prevent several murders Flippy spirals into depression, even temporarily giving up his protagonist role to [url=/c143357]Pete[/url] during the second trial due to his inability to act as a leader.[/spoiler]
